==Notes==
*This boss shares four [[spawn]] points with four other bosses: [[Sakalo Yawpyawl]], [[Salani Pippip]], [[Ipillo Wupwup]], and [[Karobo Dimdim]]. This means that a random one of these five will not spawn per map [[instance]].

== Trivia==
